instruction: I'd like to see relative line numbers in Vim to make it easier to jump between lines. Please search online for how to enable relative line numbers in Vim and configure it permanently in my local Vim settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

parameters.command:
cat > eval_relnumber__366c20da.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if grep -q "set relativenumber" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null || grep -q "set rnu" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Relative Line Numbers Set!"
else
    echo "Relative numbers not configured"
fi
EOF
chmod +x eval_relnumber__366c20da.sh
